claims.text: Deep learning-based generation models are prone to hallucinating unintended text.
Hallucinated text degrades system performance in real-world Natural Language Generation scenarios.

evidence.description: The authors state that deep learning based generation is prone to hallucinate unintended text.
The authors state that unintended hallucinations degrade system performance and fail to meet user expectations.

methodologies.name: Literature Survey
methodologies.description: A comprehensive survey reviewing research progress, metrics, mitigation methods, and task-specific research on hallucinations in Natural Language Generation.

limitations.text: Studies on measuring and mitigating hallucinated texts in NLG had never been reviewed in a comprehensive manner prior to this survey.
